question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a brown present, Bob has a green present, Claire has a red present, Dave has a gold present, Eve has a yellow present, Fred has a silver present, and Gertrude has a grey present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Eve swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) brown present
(B) green present
(C) red present
(D) gold present
(E) yellow present
(F) silver present
(G) grey present
solution:
Holder order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial gift colors: brown | green | red | gold | yellow | silver | grey
1. Bob ↔ Dave: brown | gold | red | green | yellow | silver | grey
2. Alice ↔ Eve: yellow | gold | red | green | brown | silver | grey
3. Bob ↔ Claire: yellow | red | gold | green | brown | silver | grey
4. Eve ↔ Claire: yellow | red | brown | green | gold | silver | grey
5. Dave ↔ Alice: green | red | brown | yellow | gold | silver | grey
6. Dave ↔ Eve: green | red | brown | gold | yellow | silver | grey
7. Bob ↔ Eve: green | yellow | brown | gold | red | silver | grey
Gertrude has the grey present, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
